frame.what: data/centerline.local.json's local frame (x east, z north), tools/author_expansion.Frame

_doc: Phase 3 routes lens on fresh OSM (scripts/p3x_legs.py): the legs in both directions (cw = the plan's clockwise J2 -> J6 -> J7 -> J3, acw = back; Phase 2's file calls them fwd / rev), way lists, one-way-aware paths, controls on the path, the turns at J2 / J6 / J7 / J3 over 20 m chords, the median crossings. Lengths are in data/centerline.local.json's local frame (the build's frame); the plan's lengths run ~0.2 % shorter (another metric), as Phase 2's routes lens against data/expansion.north.json.
